name: Changelogify AI
description: Optional, evidence-backed BYOK AI drafting for Changelogify releases.
project_description: Changelogify AI is an optional submodule of Changelogify that adds evidence-backed, bring-your-own-key AI drafting for release notes. Using the Drupal AI module's configured chat provider (credentials managed by Drupal AI and Key, never by Changelogify), it can synthesize a whole draft release from the eligible, policy-filtered evidence in a release window, rewrite individual release-note items, or rewrite an entire release for clarity. Every AI action is grounded in already-recorded evidence, requires an explicit administrator consent toggle plus a granular per-editor permission, sends only a filtered and redacted payload, and never publishes or changes source content on its own — suggestions are staged for editorial review before being accepted into a new release revision.
